name: spectra-desk
description: Single-fire OSINT report delivery for researchers — public sources, fully sourced, archived

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix desktop
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && npm run build --prefix desktop && npm run prepare:resources --prefix desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:desktop && npm run start --prefix desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:desktop && npm run dist:win --prefix desktop
scripts.release:github: npm run package:release && gh release create v%npm_package_version% --repo Pitchfork-and-Torch/spectra-desk --title "v%npm_package_version% Corroborate" --notes-file CHANGELOG.md dist/release/Spectra-Desk-Setup-%npm_package_version%.exe dist/release/Spectra-Desk-Portable-%npm_package_version%-win64.zip dist/release/SHA256SUMS.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
